Microfinance in 2014 — two comparable quarters, not a long trend

Report an error

01What does this evidence establish?

For the same nine microfinance providers reporting to the Yemen Microfinance Network (YMN), tables for the first and second quarters of 2014 report active borrowers, voluntary savers and outstanding loan portfolio in nominal rials; one provider's first-quarter figures date from December 2013. The two quarters are comparable only within this group of providers and are not linked to other periods.

01What does this evidence establish?02What does it measure?03Who or what does it apply to?04How current is it?05What this evidence does not establish06Original source and verification07Method and verification detail

02What does it measure?

Active borrowers, voluntary savers and outstanding loan portfolio (nominal Yemeni rials) reported by the same nine microfinance providers in Yemen Microfinance Network (YMN) tables for the first and second quarters of 2014.

03Who or what does it apply to?

The same 2014 reporting panel of nine microfinance providers for borrowers, savers and nominal portfolio.

04How current is it?

The latest observation in this record refers to the second quarter of 2014 (end of June 2014). It should not be read as describing a later period.

05What this evidence does not establish

It does not form one continuous national series with the 2012 or 2021 figures.

Limits of the measure

The nine providers are those reporting to YMN, not a census of the whole sector, and one provider's first-quarter figures date from December 2013.

07Method and verification detail

Detail for reproducing or challenging this record without changing what it means.

How was it produced?

Totals as published in the quarterly SEEP reporting tables of the Yemen Microfinance Network (YMN) for March and June 2014, covering the same nine reporting providers; one provider's first-quarter figures are reported from December 2013 data.

When does this record change?

This record is updated when an authoritative source is revised or replaced, a newer comparable observation becomes available, the definition, population or method changes, or the conditions for public use change.

How can I verify it?

This record is drawn from the source(s) listed on this page. Open a source record to reach the original document, and check that the definition, period, population and geography match what is stated here.

How should this record be read?
